scope: Proposition 4.1 (A distributional Hessian bound changes curvature) of the manuscript “Weak Hessian bounds along every geodesic in RCD spaces” (preprints/Weak-Hessian-bounds-along-every-geodesic-in-RCD-spaces-September-24-2026/weak-hessian-geodesics.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 356 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 eb34f06c23632a57), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 7. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (M, d, m) be a full-support RCD(K, N) space, where K ∈ R and 1 < N < ∞. Let F : M → R be bounded and globally Lipschitz, and let G: M → R be bounded and continuous. Suppose that for every compactly supported g ∈ Test and every nonnegative h ∈ Lipc(M), HF (∇g, ∇g)(h) ≤ ∫ hGΓ(g) dm. For every λ > 0, the measure mλ = eλF m satisfies CD(K −λG, ∞). The metric is unchanged.
